title: GPT-5 just leaked and it's terrifying

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: GPT-5 isn’t terrifying—it’s a leap forward in safety, with alignment protocols that prevent harmful outputs at the core.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: The leak shows a lack of control. If it’s already out, how can we trust it won’t be weaponized by bad actors?

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: It uses red-teaming and multi-layered filtering, tested by thousands of experts—far more secure than previous versions.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Security isn’t just about testing—it’s about access. A leak means anyone can exploit it, no matter how many filters exist.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: This isn’t just a tech issue—it’s a global risk. One leaked model could cause irreversible harm.
